title: May Korean buffet araw-araw, at kinuha ko lang ang nagustuhan ko

text.There was a Korean buffet every day, and: May Korean buffet araw-araw, at kinuha ko lang ang nagustuhan ko
text.It was delicious. I would take a lot of: Ito ay masarap. Kukuha ako ng maraming pagkain lamang na gusto ko, tulad ng Korean seaweed. Napakaganda nito.
text.The dorm floor was so shiny I could almo: Ang sahig ng dorm ay sobrang makintab na halos makita ko ang mukha ko dito
text.Clark is called the California of Southe: Clark ay tinatawag na California ng Timog-silangang Asya, at ito ay talagang mukhang
text.One good memory from Clark is that the f: Isang magandang alaala mula sa Clark ay masarap ang pagkain.
text.At the Korean restaurant there was somet: Sa Korean restaurant, may parang Korean buffet araw-araw.
